title: Obtain and renew a Florida contractor license
authority: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation
description: A business performing regulated construction work in Florida needs the appropriate certified or registered contractor license. Certified licenses are statewide; active renewal fees shown by DBPR are $105 for an individual or $155 with a qualified business, with higher late fees after the renewal deadline.
renewal: Renew by the expiration date shown by DBPR; late and reactivation fees apply after expiration.

title: Obtain and renew a Florida public food service license
authority: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation, Division of Hotels and Restaurants
description: A Florida public food service establishment must obtain the applicable Division of Hotels and Restaurants license. Licenses renew annually on staggered county-district dates; the new or change-of-ownership application fee is $50, and full-year or half-year license fees depend on classification, seating, county and application date.
renewal: Renew on the annual district date: October 1, December 1, February 1, April 1 or June 1, depending on county.

title: Obtain and renew a Florida alcoholic beverage license
authority: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation, Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco
description: A business manufacturing, distributing or selling alcoholic beverages in Florida needs the applicable alcoholic beverage license. Annual fees vary by license type and the county population classification in the official fee chart.
renewal: Renew the annual license by the expiration date shown by the Division of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco.

title: Obtain and renew a Florida real estate license
authority: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation, Division of Real Estate
description: A person or business performing Florida real estate brokerage activities must hold the applicable DBPR real estate license. Licensees are subject to state renewal requirements and must renew through DBPR by the expiration date shown on the license.
renewal: Renew by the expiration date shown by DBPR; delinquent renewal and reactivation requirements may apply.
